name: Rahma Dome
summary: A centered ivory dome and warm twin minarets form one mosque, crowned by an attached crescent.
why: The crescent, dome, and doorway share a vertical axis. Both minarets meet the same foundation and connect through the side wings. Their caps sit on the shafts, while the dome flows directly into the hall.
risk: The symmetric composition feels familiar; its gentle palette and integrated proportions carry the character.
sub1: A sense of calm and reassurance
reasonToChoose: You want a graceful, immediately recognizable mosque with a warm character.

palette.name: RAHMA DOME / SAGE + IVORY + WARM SAND
